speaker: Doctor
text: Let me start by confirming your specific symptoms: you mentioned gait and limb ataxia. How long have you been experiencing these issues, and have they been progressive? Also, do you experience any tremors or weakness in your limbs?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that detail. Have you noticed any recent changes in your vision, such as double vision or difficulty focusing, and do you experience any slurred speech or swallowing difficulties?

Also, could you tell me if you have a known history of conditions like diabetes, thyroid issues, or if you've been taking any new medications recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.
